title: Define authoritative Client/Project identity and local directory read contracts
owner: Client and Project Domain Read Contracts

requirements.invariant: A target Client has stable opaque ClientID, immutable AccountID, required current display name, explicit active/archived state and ordered audit timestamps; display text is not identity.

Every target Project identifies exactly one Client by ClientID in the same Account; copied or equal Client names never establish, repair or authorize that relationship, while a current display summary may be denormalized in an immutable read model.

requirements.section: Clients, Projects, notes, preferences, and reference data
requirements.invariant: One backend-neutral ClientProjectDirectoryQuerying port exposes Account-scoped local Client and Project snapshot streams using domain and standard Swift types only; it contains no generic CRUD, provider listener or backend SDK type.

Client and Project lists are immutable query read models with stable query/cursor identity, LocalDataVersion, readiness/quality and as-of evidence; authoritative empty, no matches and incomplete or stale local scope are never collapsed.

Directory domain/read contracts depend only on standard Swift and provider-free target-core contracts, allocate no identity, open no state and expose stable bounded refusal without raw names, paths, queries or vendor payloads.

This Phase 1 contract is executable with synthetic deterministic adapters while the released Firebase app remains unchanged and no Supabase/PowerSync schema, provider, hosted resource, source transform or production authority is introduced.

items: ClientDisplayName and ProjectDisplayName preserve exact nonblank user-facing text as display values only; no normalized name, equality or ordering result can produce ClientID, ProjectID, AccountID or authorization.
ClientSummary carries ClientID, immutable AccountID, display name, active/archived state and created/updated times with createdAt no later than updatedAt.

ProjectSummary carries ProjectID, immutable AccountID, exact current ClientSummary, Project display name, optional description and active/archived state; construction and decoding require matching AccountID and exact ClientID relationship evidence.

ClientListSnapshot and ProjectListSnapshot wrap the shared validated ListLocalSnapshot contract, require one AccountID, refuse duplicate row IDs and revalidate every row/account/relationship after restart.

ClientProjectDirectoryQuerying exposes only watchClients(accountId:) and watchProjects(accountId:) local read streams; ClientProjectDirectoryFailure provides stable safe invalid-name/time/account/relationship/duplicate codes.

postgresSchema.notApplicable: This Phase 1 provider-free contract creates no Client/Project table, column, foreign key, check, index, view or migration; the complete target vertical slice must define those after applicable gates.

serverHandlers.notApplicable: No Create/Rename/Archive/ChangeClient/Delete command, transaction, lock, idempotency result or server read handler is implemented; O-024/O-025 behavior remains unchosen.

dataApiGrants.notApplicable: No relation, view or function is exposed through the Supabase Data API.

rlsPolicies.notApplicable: Same-Account value validation is not authorization. No server rows, membership predicate, grants or RLS policies exist in this slice.

syncStreams.notApplicable: The read port consumes local snapshots but defines no PowerSync Stream, bucket parameter, local table, download authorization or provider readiness proof.

items: Client/Project values and directory snapshots are immutable Codable evidence and reconstruct only through the same name/time/account/relationship/duplicate validators.
The shared ListLocalSnapshot contract retains query fingerprint, bounded rows, visible-row count, completeness, ready/partial/stale quality, LocalDataVersion and canonical as-of time across restart.

Cross-Account Client embedding, mismatched Client identity, duplicate Client/Project IDs, invalid times, blank names and incomplete-authoritative claims fail atomically without returning a partial directory.

storageMedia.notApplicable: Project directory values contain no image URL, AttachmentPath, byte reference, cache, upload, retention or deletion behavior.

appMcp.notApplicable: The shared read port and DTO semantics are defined, but no concrete Swift UI context, MCP TypeScript projection, transport handler or entry point is wired in this foundation slice.

migrationReconciliation.notApplicable: No Firebase project/clientName is transformed and no Client is created or inferred. Later migration must correlate every Project to one reviewed Client or quarantine it explicitly.

observabilityRunbooks.notApplicable: Stable local failure codes are contract values only; no telemetry emission, metric, alert or runbook action is added.

items: The implementation remains inside the existing provider-free LedgerTargetCore and test targets and is not linked by changing either application project.
This slice cannot activate Client/Project features, choose Client merge/Project reassignment/deletion, authorize reads, provision a database, import source data, deploy, release or cut over.

verification.expected: Valid Account-scoped Client/Project summaries and local list snapshots preserve exact stable ID relationships, display text, lifecycle, timestamps and shared list metadata without a provider dependency.

Representative ready/partial/authoritative-empty Client and Project directory evidence round-trips byte-identically through canonical restart and an in-memory read port without opening disk, network or provider state.

Blank display names, reversed Client audit times, cross-Account or mismatched Project/Client relationship, duplicate IDs, malformed decoded rows and incomplete-as-authoritative snapshots fail atomically with stable non-enumerating codes.

verification.owner: pull-request CI Isolated target environment job
verification.expected: The exact implementation commit passes conversion traceability, provider/source-contamination and generated-contract checks, the complete target suite, both target builds and clean artifacts without changing an application project or claiming schema, authorization, provider, migration or production behavior.

notes: Decision-independent Phase 1 read-domain foundation only. It implements current Client/Project identity and local list semantics but no product command, Client merge/reassignment/deletion behavior, schema/RLS/Sync/provider, app/MCP entry point, migration, hosted resource, production access or cutover. O-024/O-025 remain fully open for the excluded mutation/lifecycle surfaces.
